faq.question: Can I change plans later?
faq.answer: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time. We will prorate the difference.

faq.question: Is there a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes. Every plan includes a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.

faq.question: What counts as a device?
faq.answer: A device is any physical sensor, gateway, or edge node that reports data through our platform.

faq.question: Do you offer on-premise deployment?
faq.answer: On-premise and VPC deployments are available on Enterprise plans.

faq.question: Can I export my data?
faq.answer: Yes. Data can be exported as CSV or JSON at any time from the dashboard.

faq.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.answer: We accept all major cards, UPI, and bank transfers for annual plans.

faq.question: Do prices include taxes?
faq.answer: Listed prices do not include applicable taxes. Indian customers will be charged GST.

faq.question: How do I get support?
faq.answer: Email support@inizh.tech or visit our support hub for documentation and FAQs.
